.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/test.sh (and tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, scoring.toml, Dockerfile by hash)
evidence: tests/test.sh is byte-identical to the frozen template (sha256 bd682592... for both task/tests/test.sh and rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/test.sh); tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, scoring.toml and tests/Dockerfile also hash-equal to the template. bash -n passes, no CR bytes, shebang at line 1. Contract traced line by line against staged-task-contract.md:98-111: (1) write_zero_reward at test.sh:60 runs before any gating, trap cleanup EXIT at :61 calls ensure_reward (:39, :20-23), zero record at :8 carries reward, five dimensions, gates_passed, floors_passed, weighted_score, graded, no_op. (2) No exec of the script (only 'find -exec chmod' at :86). (3) Missing /app/server.js -> exit 0 with zero (:68-70); symlinks escaping /app/node_modules -> exit 0 with zero (:72-83), and that rule is disclosed to the builder at environment/instructions/integration.md:11; the golden tree has no symlinks. (4) /app copied aside (:90-95); app launched with setsid env -i PATH/NODE_PATH/HOME/PORT/DB_PATH and setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups (:104-111); LOG_DIR is chmod 700 under umask 077 (:3,:10-11) and /tests is go-rwx (:12), so the uid-65534 app cannot read criteria or write the reward. (5) Liveness on /api/health then / for up to 120 x 0.25 s before RewardKit, not ready -> exit 0 with zero (:42-58, :115-125). (6) Restart helper generated by heredoc + sed, chmod 755, APP_RESTART_HELPER exported (:127-193) and referenced at scored/functional/judge.toml:18. (7) gates suite first (:213), then score.py (:217) with 0 continue / 1 stop keeping the detailed zero record / other -> write_zero_reward (:218-222). (8) scored suite (:224) then score.py (:227) with '|| write_zero_reward'. Failure paths all leave a reward: gates suite crash or timeout -> exit 0 with the initial zero; scored suite crash or timeout -> exit 0 with the record score.py wrote after gates, which is reward 0.0 because scored_data is None so floors_passed is false (score.py:38-48), and stale scored output is removed first (test.sh:212, :205); a set -e abort anywhere (for example cp -a at :92) still fires the EXIT trap. Budgets nest: 600+600 < 1500, 9000+900+900 < 11100, 1500+11100 < 13200 (task.toml:27). Weak-app probe: an app answering only 404 on /api/health passes liveness (HTTPError counts as up, :51-52) but then meets the two gates, so it cannot score; an app that dies after readiness yields gate failure or suite failure and a zero. Conforming-alternative probe: an app that keeps a symlink outside node_modules is zeroed, but the brief states that restriction, so it is not a hidden requirement. Run evidence (earlier candidate, not these bytes; entrypoint is template-controlled): hosted Oracle trial wrote reward.txt 0.9833 with gates/ and scored/ outputs and 'app-restart pid=1961 ready=1'; hosted model trial with a failed render gate wrote reward.txt 0.0000, graded=1, gates_passed=0 and no scored/ directory, i.e. the exit-1 path stopped before the scored suite; the nop trial wrote 0.0. No tests/test.sh run exists on these exact task bytes, and the crash/timeout paths (suite timeout, score.py exit 2, liveness failure) were verified by reading, not by execution.
